raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "timehash" %}
{% set version = "1.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/abeusher/{{ name }}/archive/{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d942954383efc1b813c0b67c1ce568153176c47b6032c9b8a688efd30643ed2b

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 2
  script: "{{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv "

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python
  run:
    - python

test:
  imports:
    - timehash

about:
  home: https://github.com/abeusher/timehash
  license: BSD 3-clause
  license_family: BSD
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: "Module to encode and decode timestamps to/from TimeHashes"

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mxr-conda
    - adbeda
    - oblute
    - rluria14
